title: Technicians Board Layout Deck
request: Oct 19 2026 12:04 ICT: Max's decided Technicians board sections in order: Documents, tech-only company calendar, who's working this week, urgent and safety flags (gas, electrical, CO, flooding pinned at the top), visits log with photos and notes; ping log in the branded footer; every section switches day/week/month. 12:07: sections confirmed, pairs are only about looks; Certifications and Training is optional and shown only in pairs labelled Optional.
example_data: Laptop browser mockups (1366 wide) of the Technicians board with sample techs Tech Dash 1-3, tagged TEST / SAMPLE. No real names, addresses or phones.

Mockups: white/cream base, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, UP house mark, light only
